sections.heading: Taxon mapping confidence
reference: Reference: 2019 landings; all exact catch labels, including unidentified and zero-catch records; no taxon or group filter.
24 ecological source groups (+1 computational import); 276 catch labels.
Simple-chain PPR totals 370,210,805.58 t C in 2019.
22 labels lack a saved classic coefficient/TL; all have zero 2019 landings and zero annual PPR. Unavailable TL remains ?, not zero.
Method: simple trophic chain.
Full taxon mapping appendix and descriptive Sources sheet
The summary uses the weaker required membership or allocation confidence. The following tables show each component separately.
Group assignment rules

Membership evidence: focal Table S1 and all taxon decisions. Representative lists are not exhaustive family definitions. Bony residuals exclude dedicated cartilage but retain eligible mixed guilds and named fish groups.
Allocation weight rules

Weights and assumptions: 12 split labels use complete positive 2018 Table S4 catch proportions; 15 use M2018 biomass after incomplete or censored source catch. Both have Medium allocation confidence. S4 is M1997 Ecosim calibration data, not a native M2018 catch vector. Whole-guild proxies are transferred across years, areas, fleets and catch bases. Allocation evidence | Historical donor reconstruction
Each rule percentage is the independent simple-chain PPR associated with taxa using that rule.

Unresolved taxa: none. The 26 Very low decisions cover 14.1427% of landings and 4.8247% of simple-chain PPR. The same cohort contributes 14.17% of GE, 12.25% of TE and 13.74% of With Egestion PPR under the reference controls. Method-specific contributions
